value.rationale: The update repairs the source contracts rather than the labels. Service rows remain distinct host-named occurrences, including oppositely directed work relationships. Payment media are constrained only when expressly stated, so “in hay” yields hay while dollar notation alone yields neither cash nor null. An express “paid … to … for …” clause now constrains service_event_id to the uniquely role-matching observed service ID, including nominal host IDs. Work periods remain attached solely to service rows; payment time, venue, kinship, and absent optional properties are not inferred.
